calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag, p.subcategory AS subcat_was, cp.subcategory AS subcat_asis, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT subcat_asis, SUM(quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl,
  SUM(CASE WHEN subcat_was<>subcat_asis THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_diff_was, SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units
FROM sold GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 8

calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.*, p.category, p.subcategory
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
)
SELECT 'all_incl_test' AS k, SUM(quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(quantity) AS minq, MAX(quantity) AS maxq, COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts, MIN(sale_date) AS d0, MAX(sale_date) AS d1, COUNT(DISTINCT sale_date) AS days FROM sold
UNION ALL SELECT 'excl_test', SUM(quantity), COUNT(*), MIN(quantity), MAX(quantity), COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), MIN(sale_date), MAX(sale_date), COUNT(DISTINCT sale_date) FROM sold WHERE category <> 'ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'control', SUM(units_sold), NULL, NULL, NULL, SUM(receipts), MIN(business_date), MAX(business_date), COUNT(*) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=118 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

SELECT cp.subcategory, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS returned_units
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 118 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND cp.subcategory IN ('Fixings & Fasteners','Indoor Lighting','Storage Boxes','Cleaning Products','Plants & Flowers')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
